Understanding Cryptocurrency Price Feeds and Portfolio Valuation
Intermediate
Understanding Cryptocurrency Price Feeds and Portfolio Valuation

Learn how digital asset prices are calculated, aggregated, and applied to virtual portfolios.

Your progress
0%
Earn the
Crypto Data Specialist
badge on completion

Explore the mechanics behind cryptocurrency price feeds, from raw exchange tickers and volume-weighted averages to data aggregation methodologies, API delays, and paper-portfolio valuation techniques.

What you'll be able to do
Calculate volume-weighted average prices using exchange ticker data
Explain why outlier filtering requires the provider’s methodology and observation timestamps
Analyze the impact of API delays on virtual portfolio execution
Value a paper-trading portfolio using real-time and snapshot price feeds
Before you start

Basic understanding of spot trading concepts and simple mathematical averages.

How the lessons build on each other

Start with venue tickers and a volume-weighted arithmetic example, then compare observation times and delayed portfolio marks. Finish with cash-inclusive allocation and a fee-aware rebalance. These lessons do not establish readiness for statistical trading or algorithmic execution.

Who this track is not for

Individuals seeking real-time high-frequency trading execution strategies or automated arbitrage bots.

Lessons
LESSON 1
Exchange Tickers and Price Aggregation Foundations
Learn how individual cryptocurrency exchanges generate ticker prices and how data aggregators synthesize this information into a unified market rate.
8 min
LESSON 2
API Delays and Portfolio Valuation Mechanics
Examine how data transmission delays, API snapshots, and cache intervals impact the valuation and execution of virtual portfolios.
8 min
LESSON 3
Portfolio Rebalancing and Cash Drag Dynamics
Learn how to rebalance a virtual portfolio with cash components and manage the impact of transaction delays on asset allocation.
8 min
